answers.answer_text: In the environmental impact assessment the public participation plays a major role because while designing a project, it can cause harm to human beings in many ways. Negative impacts can include: loss of plantation due to cutting down trees and plants, loss of habitats of human beings as well as other living organisms, loss of land etc.

x Impact evaluation
Identify the impacts and evaluate the impacts and check how much useful and less harmful it is.

x. Mitigation measures
Take the corresponding mitigation measures to reduce the negative impact and during build the project.
It includes:-
- planting trees on both sides to not to disturb the ecosystem for cutting trees.
- Relocate/Rehabilitate people to safer places.
